title: FileNode capability: add supportedNodeTypes (-16 §2.1)
description: draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-16 §2.1 adds supportedNodeTypes to the capability object. crate-jmap-filenode-types capability.rs lacks it and still cites -14. Client test fixtures in crate-jmap-filenode-client also still use -14 keys (no assertions depend on them).
